title: The P-vertex problem for graphs with perfect matchings
summary: Sharma and Panda recently proved that every bipartite graph with a perfect matching has property (P); that is, it admits a non-singular real symmetric matrix with support graph G for which every vertex is a P -vertex. In this paper, we extend their result from bipartite graphs to arbitrary graphs. To this end, we introduce the notion of a P - vertex covering and define the P -vertex covering number p(G) as the minimum number of non-singular matrices in S(G) needed so that every vertex of G is a P -vertex of at least one of them.
